overallAccuracy.description: Overall classification accuracy across all 6 classes including UNRESOLVED.

selectiveAccuracyOnPositiveCoverage.description: True selective accuracy on positive geographic decisions (72/75 = 96.00%).

previouslyReportedSelectiveAccuracyDiscr.explanation: The previously reported 96.91% counted the 22 safe UNRESOLVED abstentions in the numerator while excluding only the 3 conservative false negative abstentions in the denominator. When evaluated strictly on positive geographic assertions, the accurate figure is 72 / 75 = 96.00%.

selectedOutletsCoverageNotice.precisionStatus: UNDEFINED (0 true positives out of 2 positive predictions; gold support = 0)
selectedOutletsCoverageNotice.auditFinding: The 100-offer holdout contains zero gold-standard examples of SELECTED_OUTLETS. Claiming 100% precision or recall for this class was an artifact of collapsing or division-by-zero handling. Phase 9 builds a dedicated, authentic 25-offer benchmark of selected-outlet promotions.

exactPinRecallOnPhysicalVenues.explanation: While exact-pin precision is 100% (11/11 pins placed correspond to verified venues), exact-pin recall is 15.07% (11/73) because previous blanket rules suppressed pins for multi-branch chains and selected outlets.
